insight: Founded by Stanford professor Tengyu Ma; acquired by MongoDB in Feb 2025 (~$220M) after raising ~$28M from Snowflake and Databricks.
name: Voyage AI
tagline: Retrieval-specialized embedding and reranking models for RAG.
description: Voyage AI builds retrieval-specialized embedding and reranking models served via API to ground LLM applications. Its voyage-3 series of text and code embeddings, domain-tuned variants, and rerank models (e.g. rerank-2.5) are aimed at higher RAG accuracy than general-purpose embeddings. Now part of MongoDB, its models are being woven into Atlas Vector Search while the standalone API continues to operate.

modelSupport.notes: Serves its own embedding and reranker models; not an LLM gateway.

edge: Retrieval-tuned embeddings + rerankers (voyage-3.5, rerank-2.5) built to beat general-purpose embedding models on RAG benchmarks.
cons: Roadmap now tied to MongoDB Atlas

references.title: Voyage AI is building RAG tools to make AI hallucinate less
